title: Japan Fired a Copper Bullet at an Asteroid at 4,500 mph

scenes.text: Japan shot a copper bullet at an asteroid.
The probe Hayabusa2 dropped a small explosive device near Ryugu.
When it blew, a copper plate fired out at two kilometers a second.
That is about forty-five hundred miles an hour.
Then the probe raced to the far side of the asteroid to hide from the debris.
It was making a crater on purpose, to reach rock hidden below the surface.
Later, it brought samples home. A copper bullet, fired at an asteroid, on purpose.

description:
Japan shot a copper bullet at an asteroid.
In April 2019, Hayabusa2 released a roughly 2 kg copper plate at about 2 km per second to dig into the asteroid Ryugu.
What would you dig for?
